tm.ansicht.abgeleitet: Derived view: PES stores a single formation.
tm.fuer.hinweis: PES keeps one plan: both views show the same draft.
tm.assistent.hinweis: The assistant only sets switches, sliders and formation in the draft. Nothing goes to the game.
tm.assistent.oop_hinweis: PES has no formation out of possession: it is kept as a note only.
tm.rat.leer: No advice right now: the line-up is incomplete or not read.
tm.rat.hinweis: Advice from the PESM tactics engine (heuristic). It writes nothing to the game.
tm.aktionen.hinweis: Draft in PESM only. It goes to the game only via Continue at the top right.
tm.leer.standards: No line-up read yet: captain and takers appear after reading the save.
tm.leer.elfmeter: No line-up read yet: the penalty taker appears after reading the save.
tm.leer.gegner: No next match yet: the opposition report appears once a match is scheduled.
tm.leer.hinweis: This tab only displays and writes nothing to the game.
tm.standards.hinweis: Current value from the save. Changes are a draft in PESM; the assignment of set pieces is not individually confirmed.
tm.elfmeter.rangliste: Suitability (PESM score from finishing, shot power, ball control, morale)
tm.elfmeter.reihenfolge_kennt_nicht: PES has no order of takers for a shoot-out; the game picks them itself.
tm.gegner.pes_text: Attack 1/2 and defence 1/2 with type and target; order and types are assumed.
tm.gegner.fm_text: Tight marking, tackling harder or showing onto a foot per opposition player does not exist in PES.
tm.mapping.hinweis: Every element of the Football Manager tactics planner, classified: writable, display only or not in PES. Writable means a write path is built; untested fields stay PESM-only until approved.
tm.stil.ballbesitz.name: Ball possession
tm.stil.ballbesitz.text: A style that keeps the ball and wins it back quickly. Build-up from the back, short passes, patience.
tm.stil.ballbesitz.minus1: Playing out from the back is risky.
tm.stil.gegenpressing.name: Counter-press
tm.stil.gegenpressing.text: High defensive line, early pressure on the ball, fast transition after winning it.
tm.stil.gegenpressing.minus2: Vulnerable to balls behind the line.
tm.stil.fluegelspiel.name: Wing play
tm.stil.fluegelspiel.text: The attack runs down the flanks; wingers and full-backs stretch the play.
tm.stil.direktspiel.name: Route one
tm.stil.direktspiel.text: Long balls to the forwards, short routes to goal, little build-up.
tm.stil.konterspiel.name: Counter-attack
tm.stil.konterspiel.text: Sit deep, offer space and play in behind straight after winning the ball.
tm.stil.catenaccio.name: Catenaccio
tm.stil.catenaccio.kurz2: Defend with five at the back.
tm.stil.catenaccio.text: Deep block with a back five; goals are rare on both sides.
tm.stil.catenaccio.minus1: Hardly any chances of its own.
tm.map.formation.hinweis: Position codes and slots of the 11 places; confirmed in game 17/18 Oct (centre-backs swapped their field position)
tm.map.startelf.hinweis: Squad slots 0 to 22; goalkeeper/striker swap confirmed in game, undo confirmed
tm.map.standards.fm: Set-piece takers (long/short free kick, second taker, corners)
tm.map.standards.hinweis: Row +576 to +580; assignment per byte assumed
tm.map.schalter.fm: Switches (attacking style, build-up, attack area, positioning, defensive style, control area, pressing)
tm.map.schalter.hinweis: Seven 0/1 switches per tactics group; display confirmed on 15 Oct
tm.map.regler.fm: Sliders support area, defensive line, compactness
tm.map.anweisungen.hinweis: Type and squad slot; order and types assumed
tm.map.spielstil.hinweis: Display confirmed in game (player field, not tactics)
tm.map.rolle_ballbesitz.hinweis: PES has playing styles instead of roles; the role is a PESM heuristic from the 25 abilities
tm.map.rolle_ohne_ball.hinweis: PES has no role out of possession; PESM derives a behaviour from position and pressing
tm.map.ansicht_ballbesitz.fm: Views in possession / out of possession / both
tm.map.ansicht_ballbesitz.hinweis: PES stores one formation (three sets, meaning assumed); the views are derived
tm.map.eignung.hinweis: PESM calculation (fit to position and role), not from the game
tm.map.vertrautheit.hinweis: PESM calculation from position grades A/B/C; team spirit is not readable
tm.map.intensitaet.hinweis: PESM derivation from pressing and defensive line
tm.map.gegnerbericht.hinweis: PESM evaluation from table, form and save
tm.map.datenhub.hinweis: Evaluations from season statistics and reports
tm.map.mentalitaet.hinweis: PES has no mentality; PESM shows a derived classification
tm.map.stil.hinweis: PES has switches, not styles; the assistant only sets switches in the draft
tm.map.taktik_slot.hinweis: PES: three tactics groups, active group not measured; variants = formation sets
tm.map.spieler_angriff.fm: Sliders players in attack / in defence
tm.map.gegneranweisungen.hinweis: PES has no instructions per opposition player; only the defensive instructions with target (man-marking) exist
tm.map.teamanweisungen_fm.fm: Team instructions such as tempo, time wasting, pass risk, dribbling, crossing
tm.map.teamanweisungen_fm.hinweis: PES only has the seven switches and three sliders
